subject: design/feature-draft-readiness
statement: Judge draft currency, citations, PRD structure, and decision links from compiled records and a pinned mainline through one shared verdict.
intent: Give local checks, the pull request check, and lock preparation the same readiness result for the same draft and mainline.
rationale: The compiler preserves explicit links, the citation scanner shares the document gate grammar, and the verdict reads exact mainline memory and document bytes; malformed or stale references stay visible until repaired.
fit_criterion: Condition fixtures, local and hosted parity, the no-draft check, and the Go race and coverage gates pass.
